children: ITC shares jumped nearly 3 percent in morning trade on September 1, emerging among the top gainers on the Nifty 50 after its subsidiary ITC Infotech announced a deal to acquire a promoter stake in Happiest Minds Technologies, followed by a merger of the two IT services companies.

The stock was trading 2.84 percent higher at Rs 262.75 in morning trade, after rising as much as 4.7 percent earlier in the session. The rally comes after a sharp decline in the stock this year, with ITC down 27.8 percent year-to-date, compared with an 8.1 percent fall in the Nifty 50. The company's market capitalisation stood at more than Rs 3.29 lakh crore.

Under the transaction announced on August 31, ITC Infotech will acquire a 22.1 percent promoter stake in Happiest Minds from founder and executive chairman Ashok Soota and Ashok Soota Medical Research LLP for Rs 1,329.72 crore. The acquisition will take place in two tranches.

In the first tranche, ITC Infotech will acquire 1.675 crore shares, representing an 11 percent stake in Happiest Minds, at Rs 390 apiece for Rs 653.26 crore. It will subsequently acquire another 1.691 crore shares, or an 11.106 percent stake, at Rs 400 apiece for Rs 676.46 crore.

title: ITC shares jump nearly 3%, among top Nifty gainers after Happiest Minds-ITC Infotech merger deal
